chapters.title: 01 · Welcome to OUD & AURA
chapters.detail: A fictional Arabian fragrance boutique. All prices and payments are demonstration data.

chapters.title: 02 · Explore fragrance families
chapters.detail: Three collections connect directly to filtered product browsing.

chapters.title: 03 · Search, filter, and sort together
chapters.detail: Product-name search is case-insensitive. Both price directions work alongside category filters.

chapters.title: 04 · Product details and quantity
chapters.detail: Choose a whole-number quantity. Stock limits apply to both purchasing actions.

chapters.title: 05 · Add to Cart
chapters.detail: The notification offers View cart. Repeated products merge into one cart line.

chapters.title: 06 · Buy only the items you select
chapters.detail: Selected totals update immediately; unselected items remain for later.

chapters.title: 07 · Validate before saving
chapters.detail: Required guest fields are checked. The cart and stock remain unchanged when validation fails.

chapters.title: 08 · Review delivery, payment, and total
chapters.detail: Guest checkout uses fictional contact details and a simulated payment choice. Subtotal equals total.

chapters.title: 09 · Save the order atomically
chapters.detail: A Pending order, item snapshots, stock deduction, and purchased cart removal are saved together.

chapters.title: 10 · Return through My Orders
chapters.detail: Guest orders remain accessible in the same browser and show their current saved status.

chapters.title: 11 · Demo admin login
chapters.detail: SessionStorage protects navigation for this assessment demo. It is not production authentication.

chapters.title: 12 · The matching order in admin
chapters.detail: The customer details, notes, quantities, snapshot prices, and total match checkout.

chapters.title: 13 · Confirm, then prepare
chapters.detail: Only the next status is offered: Pending → Confirmed → Preparing.

chapters.title: 14 · Ship, then complete
chapters.detail: Shipped → Completed. Completed and Cancelled are final; backwards or skipped transitions are rejected.

chapters.title: 15 · Accurate overview metrics
chapters.detail: Sales include Completed orders only; customers are grouped by normalized checkout email.

chapters.title: 16 · Shared catalog and preserved history
chapters.detail: Admin price edits affect future purchases. Existing order snapshots keep their original prices.

chapters.title: 17 · Buy Now and eligible cancellation
chapters.detail: Buy Now leaves the cart untouched. Cancelling Pending or Confirmed restores stock exactly once.

chapters.title: 18 · Reliable, browser-local demonstration
chapters.detail: Orders survive refresh. See README, system-flow analysis, acceptance log, and 375/768/1280 px screenshots.
